text:
maya: Quick alignment thread for SmartServe roadmap -> pilot then GA. Need owners for runtime perf, infra capacity, and security gating. Call out blockers and acceptance criteria.

raj: Runtime: adaptive batching + KV cache tweaks. Estimate 2 wks if infra slots available. Need clear latency targets.

lin: I'll do perf matrix on A100 and Tr4. Suggest pilot batch=8, GA may use 4 for low-latency. Will report numbers Tue.

olga: Infra: staging pool available week of 2024-09-18 for small pilot. GA needs reserved pool + prewarm cron. Opening ticket INF-5010.

sam: Security: need threat model + dataflow diagram before GA. HSM tests add ~10 business days. Confirm PII expectations.

fiona: I'll author the gating checklist and timeline doc: https://go.company/docs/smartserve-rollout. Add owners there.

maya: Owners: Raj runtime, Lin perf, Olga infra, Sam security, Fiona rollout. Raj please post minimal CI acceptance tests.

raj: Minimal CI checks: cold-start p95 <= 500ms (batch=1); token p95 <= 60ms; basic correctness vs golden prompts; end-to-end smoke. Will open PR Thu.

olga: INF-5010 created (https://go.company/tickets/INF-5010). Adding prewarm example: prewarm --model smartserve --pool ga --duration 2h.

sam: Drafting threat model; product: pilots will not include raw PII, but compliance requires HSM validation.

fiona: Action items: populate rollout doc by EOD Friday; sync Friday 11am PT.

infra-bot: Ticket INF-5010 created by olga (link: https://go.company/tickets/INF-5010)

maya: Thanks everyone, flag blockers here so we can rebaseline if needed.
